acceptance_criteria: All methods registered. Chat/set create-dedup works. State token deltas correct. PresenceStatus singleton auto-created. Integration test covers send flow end to end.
description:
## Why this issue exists

With the schema and bridge in place, stoa needs to implement all owner-side JMAP Chat methods so that JMAP Chat clients can create, read, and manage chats and messages. This is the API surface that clients talk to.

## Capability registration

Add `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat` to the JMAP session object returned by `GET /.well-known/jmap`. Include the account-level capability object with:
- `maxBodyBytes`, `maxAttachmentBytes`, `maxAttachmentsPerMessage`
- `maxGroupMembers`
- `supportedBodyTypes: ["text/plain"]`
- `supportsThreads: false` (v1)
- `ownerUserId` (the owner's email address)

Register all chat method names in the `Dispatcher` alongside the existing mail methods.

## Methods to implement

### Chat methods

**`Chat/get`** — return Chat objects by id. Compute `unreadCount` from `read_positions`.

**`Chat/changes`** — return changed/destroyed chat ids since a state token.

**`Chat/set`**:
- `create` with `kind: "direct"`: check for existing direct chat with `contactId`, return existing if found
- `create` with `kind: "group"`: assign dc_group_id (new UUID), set owner as admin member, send `Peer/groupUpdate` is out of scope — just create locally and the outbound bridge handles informing members on first message
- `update`: `muted`, `muteUntil`, `receiveTypingIndicators`, `pinnedMessageIds`, `messageExpirySeconds`, `receiptSharing`; group admins: `name`, `addMembers`, `removeMembers`

**`Chat/query`** — filter by `kind`, `muted`. Default sort: `last_message_at` descending.

**`Chat/queryChanges`**

**`Chat/typing`** — ephemeral; not stored. Deliver typing push event to connected clients of this account. Rate-limit to one call per chat per 3 seconds; excess silently discarded.

### Message methods

**`Message/get`** — return Message objects. Include `reactions` map from `chat_reactions`.

**`Message/changes`**

**`Message/set`**:
- `create`: insert row, trigger outbound bridge
- `update` body edit: push revision to edit history, set `edited_at`, trigger outbound bridge with edit payload (Delta Chat `Chat-Edit:` header if supported, otherwise new message with edited content)
- `update` reactions: add/remove `chat_reactions` row
- `update` readAt: set `read_at`, fire MDN if needed, update `read_positions`
- `update` deletedAt with `deletedForAll`: set `deleted_at`, clear body and attachments, trigger outbound bridge with delete payload
- `destroy`: local-only delete

**`Message/query`** — filter by `chatId` (required unless `hasMention: true`), `hasAttachment`, `hasMention`. Default sort: `received_at` ascending.

**`Message/queryChanges`**

### ChatContact methods

**`ChatContact/get`**

**`ChatContact/changes`**

**`ChatContact/set`** — `update` only: `blocked`, `displayName`. Create/destroy return `forbidden`.

**`ChatContact/query`** — filter by `blocked`. Default sort: `last_seen_at` descending.

**`ChatContact/queryChanges`**

### ReadPosition methods

**`ReadPosition/get`**

**`ReadPosition/changes`**

**`ReadPosition/set`** — `update` only: `lastReadMessageId`. Create/destroy return `forbidden`. Server sets `last_read_at` and recomputes `Chat.unreadCount`.

### PresenceStatus methods

**`PresenceStatus/get`** — returns the singleton record; server creates it if absent.

**`PresenceStatus/changes`**

**`PresenceStatus/set`** — `update` only: `presence`, `statusText`, `statusEmoji`, `expiresAt`, `receiptSharing`. Create/destroy return `forbidden`.

## State token management

Each method family has its own state token stored in the existing `state_version` table (or a parallel `chat_state_version` table). Tokens are bumped on every mutation and on inbound bridge events. `/changes` methods return added/updated/destroyed id lists since the supplied token.

## Error handling

- `notFound` for unknown ids
- `forbidden` for create/destroy on singleton types
- `rateLimited` for `Chat/typing` excess calls
- `invalidArguments` for `Message/query` without `chatId` and without `hasMention: true`
- `maxSizeExceeded` for body exceeding `maxBodyBytes`

## Acceptance criteria

- All listed methods registered in Dispatcher and return correct responses
- `Chat/set` create direct: second create with same contactId returns existing chat, not a new one
- `Message/set` create: outbound bridge triggered (verified in integration test)
- `ReadPosition/set` update: `Chat.unreadCount` reflects new cursor
- `PresenceStatus/get` returns singleton even if never explicitly created
- State tokens advance on mutation; `/changes` returns correct delta
- Unit tests for each method using an in-memory `MailStore` mock
design: All methods are registered in the existing Dispatcher — same dispatch infrastructure as mail methods. Chat state tokens are separate from mail state tokens (different type names in the state_version table). The PresenceStatus singleton is auto-created on first get if absent — same pattern as ReadPosition.
title: JMAP Chat: owner-side methods
